pages.title: Lightning Spear
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r II$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Trident$(br2)§lEffect: §r A thrown trident calls down lightning at the struck entity: Level I requires rain, Level II works in any weather and any dimension.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with Channeling.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
